# WE5 · Dịch vụ

Group **WE · Ảnh, bác sĩ & phòng, dịch vụ** · page · Next.js: **planned (U4)** (`/services`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/operations-ui.js#services`
- Studio is `clinic.js › studio()/photos()`; resources and services are `operations-ui.js › resources()/services()` with the dialogs `block` and `service`.
- `operations-ui.js › services()`: service cards (price, duration, buffer, rooms, active) with "Chỉnh dịch vụ".
- Page key `services` is allowed for roles: owner (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"services\"]"}; it must show `[data-ops="service"]`.

- Route: `/services` · status: **planned (U4)** · U step: U4

## Layout (top to bottom, region → src/ui component)
Every field, action, status, filter and text of the old screen is listed; rows and cards that repeat show the first one with demo values and their count. `old="…"` is the old CSS class, `// key=value` the old `data-*` hook that carries the behaviour.
```tsx
<AppShell role="owner-tam">  // sidebar and top bar are the same on every page (WA1-WA3); active menu item "Dịch vụ", page key "services"
  <PageHeading eyebrow="Vận hành · dữ liệu giả lập" title="Danh mục dịch vụ" subtitle="Giá và thời lượng dùng cho lịch mới. Lịch đã đặt giữ giá và thời lượng tại lúc đặt." />
  <Grid old="service-grid" cols="repeat(2, minmax(0px, 1fr))" gap="20px">
    <Repeat of=".service-card" count={4} also-classes="panel service-S0 service-S1 service-S2 service-S3">  // first item shown (demo values); the others have the same shape
      <Card old="panel service-card service-S0">
        <Badge tone="success" old="status status-green">"Đang dùng"</Badge>
        <Heading level={2}>"Tái khám & đánh giá"</Heading>
        <Text old="service-price">"300.000 ₫"</Text>
        <Text old="service-details">"30 phút điều trị 0 phút chuẩn bị phòng"</Text>
        <Button variant="secondary" old="btn">"Chỉnh dịch vụ"</Button>  // ops=service
      </Card>
      <RowVariants>actions "Chỉnh dịch vụ" (secondary, ops=service) ×3 · statuses "Đang dùng" (status status-green) ×3</RowVariants>
    </Repeat>
  </Grid>
</AppShell>
```
Kit components used: PageHeading×1, Card×1, Badge×1, Button×1. Everything else (Row, Grid, Stack, Text, Heading, Progress, Avatar, Facts, Repeat, Cell…) is a plain element styled with tokens; W3 turns the recurring ones into web blocks.

## Responsive
